headline: Nvidia launches platform to quarantine rogue AI agents, plus stock buyback
summary: Nvidia introduced a new platform designed to contain and quarantine AI agents that go rogue, described variously as an open-source system or a combined hardware-and-software stack. The launch coincided with a $150 billion stock buyback. OpenAI is privately working with Nvidia on the effort despite not publicly endorsing it.

claims.statement: Nvidia launched a new platform to contain and quickly quarantine rogue AI agents.
